technical.summary: Strong technical structure with price above all key MAs and bullish momentum indicators, but elevated RSI and overbought Williams %R create pullback risk; moderate swing entry with caution on overbought conditions.

fundamental.summary: MPC shows no fundamental conviction signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk in 81 days.

sentiment.summary: No actionable congressional signal; broad market sentiment neutral with slight bearish lean (47% bearish vs 25% bullish); insufficient data for conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (271.68) indicates extreme market stress, and recent CPI print adds volatility; energy sector may benefit from USD weakness but overall environment is highly unfavourable for risk assets.

debate.key_bull_argument: Strong technical structure with price above all major MAs, bullish stochastic cross, rising RSI, and ADX trending support momentum entry into resistance at 111.38.
